yes.argument: Every one of the thirteen surviving reviews, including the three written from the existence lane, ends in "keep" or "do not close"; what they dispute is packaging, not whether the change should exist. The bug is real and reproduced (re-run here on the base and diff release builds): the example under "Extraneous asynchronous activity" in Node's documentation, which upstream also pins with a snapshot test, prints "0 fail" and exits 0 on every bun since v1.4.0, and exits 1 on Node v26.3.0 and on the diff build.
